slides.label: Overview
slides.title: OCUMEDA Website
slides.lede: Proposal for the design and Framer implementation of Ocumeda's website redesign.

items.title: The New CI
points: Applying the new CI makes the website fresh, warm and human, without feeling clinical.

items.title: Warm Med-tech
points: Approachable and trustworthy: medical expertise with a human face. "Med-tech that radiates warmth".

items.title: Show the Product
points: Showcase the product in a clear story, with mockups and photography instead of abstract animations.

rows.value: The new CI is applied across the whole website, through a style guide and UI library.
Ocumeda provides a baseline structure. Natalia helps refine it for the four main pages.
The new structure gets the building blocks it needs. The UI library is extended with new components for the redesigned pages.
New graphics and product mockups based on the new brand guidelines and the new photography style, as the main pages need them.
Structural redesign of Home, Ärzte (doctors), Optiker (opticians) and Kunden (customers), according to the new content and storyline.
Copy content is supplied by Ocumeda. Writing the copy is out of scope.
Team, Karriere, Blog and other secondary pages get no structural or content changes. The locations map stays as a placeholder. The new CI still reaches them through the components.

slides.title: Design Process & Timeline

items.title: Concept & Structure
points: Refine and finalize storyline and structure of the main pages

items.title: Visual Design
points: High-fidelity design and visual language of the website
Typography system, colour palette, UI components, spacing and layout (built on the new CI)

slides.launch: Launch first week of December (assuming kick-off on November 9th).

hosting.label: Framer hosting
hosting.disclaimer: Framer hosting stays as it is and is not part of this proposal.
